programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: En dusørjæger bliver den jagede i en kamp om overlevelse, hvor der er meget på spil. WWE-superstjernen Randy Orton og Eric Roberts spiller hovedrollerne i denne eksplosive opfølger til The Condemned.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: Tucker: The Man And His Dream
programme.desc: En bildesigner går imod hele bilindustrien med sine revolutionerende bildesigns.

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: John Wayne spiller hovedrollen som kvægbaronen George Washington McLintock, der kæmper med sin kone, datter og politiske jordbesiddere, kun for i sidste ende at »tæmme« dem alle.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Den pensionerede forbryderkonge og enlige far Paul, tvinges til at vende tilbage til Las Vegas og det kriminelle samfund, da hans datter kidnappes.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlægger finder kærligheden, da hun arbejder med at arrange det sidste bryllup på et historisk værtshus.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: Helen Mirren, Aaron Paul og Alan Rickman medvirker i denne politiske spændingsfilm. Ved en militæroperation har man chancen for at dræbe tre fremtrædende terrorister, men etikken komplicerer tingene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den kongelige ring
programme.desc: Da British Museum får Sidney og Nigel til at hjælpe med at lede efter en ring af kong Henrik VIII på Tudor-stederne, konfronteres Nigel med sin selvsikre, selvoptagede og plagsomme storebror Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sat i sten
programme.desc: I et kloster spidder Knight Gabriel en dæmon, som derefter forvandles til sten. I 2001 ankommer Nigel og Sydney med et brev fra en munk, men abbeden hævder, at det er en forfalskning, og lukker dem ude.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Deadline
programme.desc: Allan kommer til Sydney, og han har 12 timer, før en Necron-virus dræber ham, medmindre han leverer Tau til en afpresser, der har modgiften.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 70s and 80s a gang of thugs wreaked havoc on the island of Puerto Rico. Organized, experienced and deadly they seemed beyond the reach of the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Exit Through the Giftshop
programme.desc: Banksys dokumentarfilm om street art, der udforsker en franskmands forsøg på at lave en film om Banksy.

programme.title: This Property Is Condemned
programme.desc: Robert Redford and Natalie Wood headline this sexually charged Depression-era drama. Redford plays Owen Legate, a railroad official come to backwater with pink slips for the yard employees.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den afdankede sherif i en lille by i Georgia, Ben Watts, bliver presset til hurtigt at løse en gidselsituation – og indser snart, at han er en brik i et større spil blandt byens skumle hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tagelsen af krager
programme.desc: Da Lexa uden at vide det bliver bedøvet med et dødeligt stof, må holdet løbe om kap for at finde modgiften, før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Mørkets skygger
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet bliver tilkaldt for at undersøge bizarre aktiviteter, der finder sted på et lokalt hospital.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.desc: En mann kopierer de mest beryktede morderne i historien...Holly Hunter og Sigourney Weaver spiller i denne spennende thrilleren om en politietterforsker, en agorafobisk kriminalpsykolog.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: En kjent skuespiller, som ikke har takket ja til en rolle på fire år, vurderer nå en jobb. Regissørens kusine kjører ham ut av byen til en ranch hvor han vil drive research. På dette idylliske lille stedet blir han helt betatt av en av kassadamene.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Etter å ha bodd i Afrika har Cady ingen anelse om hvor 'vilt' ting kan bli i sivilisasjonen før hun møter en av de slemmeste artene som finnes, 'Dronningbien', som på denne skolen er den kule og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Vampire Zombies From Space!
programme.desc: Fra verdensrommets dyp har Dracula laget sin ondeste plan hittil: å forvandle Marlow til en hær av vampyr-zombier. En broket gruppe helter må kjempe for å redde verden.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with author David Domine to learn about the tragedy of Annie Whipple, a supposed “witch” who communicated with spirits to save the life of a child in her care.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon investigates the Conrad-Caldwell House, a Victorian-era home that’s said to still be inhabited by some of its original owners.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray-Gubler, Nicole Eggert
programme.desc: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
programme.desc: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Bret Michaels, Natasha Henstridge, Penelope Ann Miller, Eva Amurri
programme.desc: Faced with a decision that would change his life, Bret Michaels is visited by a close relative who points him toward his destiny.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden rakner når to lekre menn plutselig dukker opp: en sexy, ny klassekamerat og den søte eks-stebroren hennes. Nå oppdager hun at når det kommer til kjærlighet, er hun totalt uvitende.

programme.title: On the road
programme.desc: Dean og Sal legger ut på “livets landevei” for å finne svar på livets mysterier og litt til. Det viser seg å bli en langt mer strabasiøs ferd en de hadde tenkt seg.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Manuset er basert på bøkene The Snowden Files: The Inside Story of the World's Most Wanted Man av Luke Harding og Time of the Octopus av Anatoly Kucherena.

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En gruppe aktivister vil lage en film for å avdekke overtramp hos et stort gruveselskap, og de inngår en avtale med noen folk som lever utenfor loven, i Australias ødemark. Spenningen stiger når det viser seg at begge gruppene er på hver sin skattejakt.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spiller Frankie, en servitrise som jobber på en kaffebar i New York. Etter en rekke vonde forhold er en ny mann det siste Frankie ser etter... helt til en kommer og ser etter henne.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: When Worlds Collide
programme.desc: An impending collision with a runaway star signals the destruction of earth. As doomsday approaches, they race against time and the panic of those who will be left behind.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller Tripper Harrison, sjefsveileder på Camp North Star. Det blir underholdende når han, og den skandaløse gjengen hans av leirveiledere, har det for seg å bryte alle regler i boka.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Cosimo får en plan for en kjempejobb av sin cellekamerat. Han ber kvinnen sin om å finne en patsy for tyveriet av bilen hans, og tilbyr 15 000 dollar. Plutselig er 7 involvert.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wages of Sin
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe auksjonen av et sterkt dødelig stoff som flere beryktede internasjonale terrorister kjemper om å skaffe seg.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Breed
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir hentet inn for å hjelpe en militærbase som har blitt smittet med en dødelig sykdom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Where Evil Dwell
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe en seriemorder som etterlater ledetråder til sine neste ofre i form av gåter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserne oppfinner et eksplosivt gaveegg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney og Nigel til et kart som fører til Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babymagnet, professor og romanforfatter, ber Sydney hjelpe til med å finne Vlad Tepes 'tapte relikvie. Og han er ikke den eneste etter det.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Regis Philbin, Harry Hamlin, Ana Gasteyer, Jaime King
programme.desc: Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg
programme.desc: The county of Flintshire in Wales is said to be a land filled with ghosts and haunts. Plas Teg is said to be one of the "most haunted" houses in the area. With over 400 years of history, this place is sure to be the home of many an entity.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy er et superpopulært nyhetsanker i 1970-årenes San Diego som mener at kvinner kan pynte opp et nyhetsrom. Så når Ron får vite han skal jobbe med en smart, vakker ung dame som mestrer mer enn å være til pynt, blir det krig!

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee, en småbyjente fascinert av kjendiser, vinner en date med Hollywood-stjernen Tad Hamilton. For henne er det en drøm som går i oppfyllelse, men det betyr det totale kaos for hennes bestevenn Peter.

programme.title: A Civil Action
programme.desc: Jan er personskadeadvokat, men tar bare store saker der han kan inngå forlik utenfor rettssalen. Selv om hans nye sak først ser enkel ut, blir han snart innblandet i en episk kamp, som han er villig til å satse karrieren sin på.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Astronomen Zane oppdager intelligent utenomjordisk liv, men romvesenene holder på en dødelig hemmelighet og gjør hva som helst for å hindre Zane i å få vite den.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: En FBI-agent kler seg som en eldre dame for å beskytte en kvinne.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee, en småbyjente fascinert av kjendiser, vinner en date med Hollywood-stjernen Tad Hamilton. For henne er det en drøm som går i oppfyllelse, men det betyr det totale kaos for hennes bestevenn Peter.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En huseier mistenker at den nye losjeren hennes er galningen som dreper kvinner i London.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney støter på eksen Gray og drar på ferie med ham til Bali, men når Derek Lloyd dukker opp for å verve henne til å finne Parvati's Bowl, kan hun ikke motstå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydneys samboer fra skolen er på sporet med et anheng fra fortiden hennes og verver Sydney for å hjelpe til med å finne den og fange morderen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensomme og jevne sanden
programme.desc: Når Andromeda blir angrepet av rompirater, blir de reddet av et langt mistet romskip fra jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter Hunder av Krig
programme.desc: Mannskapet oppdager at en falsk planet, Marduk, har skapt masseødeleggelsesvåpen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: Fredagen den 13:e del 8
programme.desc: New York får stora problem då oförstörbare galningen Jason Voorhees målar staden röd.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Brain Drain
programme.desc: A man discovers a cursed trefinator in a museum warehouse: a device that transfers intelligence, the man uses it to make himself intelligent.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: What A Mother Wouldn't Do

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Spirit Of Television
programme.desc: A psychic uses a cursed antique to trade her clients' lives for a temporary cure for her degenerative disease.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: The Prisoner

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Located on the Perryville Battlefield, the site of one of the Civil War’s bloodiest fights, the HP Bottom House has purportedly witnessed countless apparitions and other chilling phenomena.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Augusta is home to Kentucky’s oldest jail, which housed prisoners since the early 1800s and still sits upon its original foundation today. While it now operates as a museum, there have been numerous guests who have claimed to see unexplainable things.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Sju främlingar med helt olika personligheter hamnar ofrivilligt i en oändlig labyrint fylld av dödliga fällor.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Han bryter sig in i deras hus, men något värre är redan där…

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Return Of The Living Dead III
programme.desc: En ung man utnyttjar ett hemligt myndighetsprojekt för att återuppliva sin döda flickvän, och hjälper henne sedan när hon förtär den enda näring hon kan – människohjärnor.

programme.title: Opera

programme.title: A Midsummer's Hawaiian Dream

programme.title: The Amityville Horror

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover

programme.title: The Assassin's Code
programme.desc: En nyutbildad kriminalinspektör som är son till en död, korrupt polis arbetar för att lösa sitt första stora fall med en skugglik mördare i hälarna.

programme.title: Defiance

programme.title: Dating Amber

programme.title: The WAY, WAY BACK

programme.title: Supersnutarna

programme.title: Självmordspatrullen

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Nursery and The Closet
programme.desc: A dangerous entity stalks a pregnant woman in her new house. A single mother discovers a terrifying secret trapped in her son's closet. The shocking eyewitness accounts of terrified people whose dream homes have become nightmares.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Unwanted Guest and Mirror Image
programme.desc: A dangerous poltergeist threatens a newly-blended family. A young woman is tormented by visions of her own gruesome death.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat
programme.desc: Paranormal activity threatens a young nurse caring for a catatonic patient. A young couple falls prey to a demonic presence in a remote cabin.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Vow of Silence and Cryptic
programme.desc: A single mother's new home was once a convent that kept a horrifying secret. A couple is tormented by the meaning of a date that keeps appearing in their new home.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Människojägaren
programme.desc: I Steve McQueens sista film får vi se den framlidne, store skådespelarens dynamiska talang i en av hans mest minnesvärda roller: den sanna historien om Ralph "Papa" Thorson, en moderna tiders prisjägare.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: varning: Den här filmen innehåller nytt material som är oklippt, skandalöst och mycket olämpligt! Bad Grandpa .5 ger dig ett helt nytt perspektiv på Irving Zismans värld, med otroliga bonusscener och kul skämt.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Sångklubben
programme.desc: Kvinnorna på en militärbas i England försöker styra sinnet från sina bekymmer och tanken på en kör tar form. Men ingen av dem hade förväntat sig att uppträda i Royal Albert Hall...

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: Cassiel är en ängel som vakar över människorna i det återförenade Berlin. Trots att änglarna egentligen inte får ingripa i människornas liv rycker Cassiel in för att rädda en liten flicka som faller ned från en balkong.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Förvandling
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Derek Lloyd beger sig till den peruanska djungeln för att leta efter Paracelsus-rullarna som innehåller formeln för att förvandla bly till guld.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Etsad i sten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Stewie Harper åker till Stockholm i Sverige för att hitta runstenen från kung Jann I av Norge.

programme.title: Andromeda: En ros i askan
programme.desc: Dylan är fängslad på en fängelseplanet och måste planera en flykt när hans besättning försöker göra sin egen räddning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det stora Neptunus hav
programme.desc: Castalianer går ombord på Andromeda för att slutföra stadgan för det Nya Samväldet. När ledaren upptäcks död är Tyr den huvudmisstänkte.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Bathroom Break / The Rat
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head decide to devote as much of their time at work as possible to bathroom breaks. / A fool and his nachos are soon parted... by a rat? A rat takes up residence and they stop at nothing.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Vägra betjäning / Yogadioten
programme.desc: Beavis prövar yogabyxor, men fårinte av sig dem./ Killarna lär sig att de har rätt att neka kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Den skumma tjejen / Tidsresenärer
programme.desc: Beavis får en hemlig beundrare i skolan./ Beavis och Butt-Head korsar delstatsgränsen om och om igen och tror att de resa i tiden.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Bounty Hunters / School Test / Going Down
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head become ace bounty hunters after a chance meeting with a reality TV. / With a big test looming, our favorite idiots receive an education in cheating. / Beavis and Butt-Head find themselves trapped in an elevator with a smokin hot chick

programme.title: RENO 911!: We Don't Want the Pope
programme.desc: The deputies provide the pope's advance scouting team with an extensive tour of Reno's seedy side.

programme.title: RENO 911!: VHS Transfer Memory Lane
programme.desc: Rizzo and Wiegel pervert-proof the Washoe County Library computers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Helping Mayor Hernandez
programme.desc: When Mayor Hernandez calls for help, the Sheriff's Department leaps into action, even if he just needs to get rid of a violent prostitute in his hotel room.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Getaway Trailer
programme.desc: Wiegel and Rizzo get to know each other better while trapped in a fleeing criminal's mobile home.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Stoner Jesus
programme.desc: A drug-addled touring company of "Jesus Christ Superstar" causes trouble in Reno.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Deputy Dance
programme.desc: Levon French, the king of Reno commercials, helps the deputies make a new recruiting ad.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Viacom Grinch
programme.desc: Declan and Junior crack down on knockoff Nickelodeon toys, ruining kids' parties across Reno.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Midnight Swingers
programme.desc: Jones and Williams penetrate the inner circle of Reno's swingers club.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa
programme.desc: What were those strange lights in the desert? Who are these new Reno Sheriff's Department deputies?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Little People
programme.desc: An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programme.desc: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Johnathan Schaech
programme.desc: Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Carole Radziwill
programme.desc: Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kesha
programme.desc: World famous singer-songwriter, Kesha revisits the Texas bed and breakfast where she encountered a paranormal apparition so tortured and disturbed it haunts her to this day.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Eric Roberts
programme.desc: Prolific film star, Eric Roberts almost lost his life in a tragic accident at the start of his career.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Brandon investigates the Conrad-Caldwell House, a Victorian-era home that’s said to still be inhabited by some of its original owners.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen medverkar i denna gripande och roliga berättelse om en pappa med en annorlunda inställning till föräldraskapet som blir tvungen att visa den moderna världen för barnen.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Pretty Baby
programme.desc: A photographer in turn-of-the-century New Orleans takes pictures of prostitutes, and eventually falls for one hooker's prepubescent daughter. A memorable film debut for Shields at 12.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pärlorna som var hans ögon
programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårarnas matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda upptäcker sitt systerskepp Pax Magellanic. Besättningen ombord på Pax är 300 år gammal... men har inte åldrats en dag.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dödlig längtan
programme.desc: Teamet försöker hindra Eckhart från att skaffa ett sällsynt ämne, men en tjuv tar det. Kvinnan som har förmågan att få män att bli förälskade i henne riktar sina ögon mot Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X: En ras från varandra
programme.desc: Mutant X möter en ny grupp nya mutanter som kallas Strand och leds av den mäktiga första mutanten Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på rakhyveln
programme.desc: När Mutant X och Genomex fångas på film när de använder sina krafter måste de båda ta itu med reportern som planerar att publicera informationen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Manos, the Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.desc: Dog butt surfs; goat jumps off trampoline after owner; dog gets mail; lizard attacks stuffed ape; dog hides in couch.

programme.title: Tarzan
programme.desc: A contemporary spin on an old story. Two decades after his parents died in the African jungle, leaving him to be raised by apes, Tarzan's billionaire uncle has him captured and brought back to New York City. Escaping captivity, he meets a police detective named Jane, who is already romantically involved with another man, leaving her to choose between civilization and humanity.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.desc: This sprawling family saga takes place where an unfortunate tragedy has glued a family together to pull them through life's thick and thin moments. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

programme.title: Switch
programme.desc: Steve Brooks (Perry King), a sexist womanizer, is killed by a group of his angry former lovers. In heaven, he makes a bargain with God for redemption and agrees to return to Earth. Once there, he must have a sincere relationship with a female and make her fall in love with him. If not, Steve's soul will become the property of the devil (Bruce Martyn Payne). But the devil hedges his bet, and Steve is reincarnated as a woman named Amanda Brooks (Ellen Barkin).

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. programme.desc: Brock and the O.S.I. come under fire from the higher ups when they lose two high value super-criminal prisoners. Somebody helped them escape, and everyone aboard the hover-quarters is a suspect in this 22 minute potboiler - even the visiting Ventures.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: A friendship built on lies threatens to unravel Dr. Venture's sanity. But Hank and Henchman 21 are the ones getting committed to an asylum. And Dean's growing relationship with a mystery woman is only making everyone crazier.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Brock and the O.S.I. launch a bold and bizarre surveillance mission against one of the Council of 13's top members. But the mission takes a turn for the worse when Doc and Billy get caught up in the super-villain crossfire.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture is missing... presumed dead. Sgt. Hatred sends Hank and Dean to live with their godfathers to keep them out of harm's way while he forges an unlikely alliance with Henchman 21 to wreak vengeance.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Join the Ventures--and pretty much everyone they've ever crossed paths with--as they rocket to the Gargantua-2 space station for an epic, hour-long adventure that will change the Ventureverse as we know it forever.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Ventures are back! And they’re movin’ on up to a deluxe apartment in the sky. But will mo’ money bring mo’ problems? And can The Monarch handle the commute?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: As White & Billy grapple with their arch enemy back in the old ‘hood, Doc realizes he can’t face his new responsibilities alone when a whale of an enemy shows him how they arch uptown.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: A brutish supervillain launches an assault on the Ventures. Will Doc’s latest invention, or a mysterious blue vigilante, save the day? Probably not.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: In a case of mistaken identity, the Guild targets Dr. Venture for assassination, pooping his party for a fancy new friend.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.sub-title: The Venture Bros. & the Curse of the Haunted Problem

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.desc: Deadly waters surround the Monarch when he becomes Wide Wale's prisoner in Part 2 of the Morphic Trilogy.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.desc: The Morphic Trilogy reaches its stunning conclusion in a decades-spanning tale of friendship, betrayal, and mass murder that overwrites Venture history.

programme.title: The Venture Bros.
programme.desc: Deep inside Guild Headquarters, The Monarch and 21 face their ultimate ordeal. Meanwhile, the Venture Brothers face one of their own.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Terrible Secret of Turtle Bay, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When the Venture Family visits Tijuana for a lecture Dr. Venture is giving at the (community) University of Mexico, the dastardly Monarch weaves a cocoon of villainy that leaves the Venture brothers trapped in his clutches, Dr. Venture kidney-less and Brock... dead? If only Dr. Venture would return the Monarch's calls...

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture, Pete White and Master Billy Quizboy are invited to take part in a top secret government think tank.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Are You There God, It's Me, Dean

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Always short on cash, Dr. Venture decides to unload some of his father's old scientific equipment in a huge yard sale that attracts fellow scientists and super-villains alike. Everyone is supposed to be on their best behavior, but The Monarch can't resist the temptation to wreak havoc once he finds himself inside the "belly of the beast"... nor can he find a bathroom.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock and Dr. Venture are kidnapped from the funeral of a college friend, the boys enlist the aid of the original Team Venture: a group of superscience adventurers who worked for their grandfather in the sixties.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Monarch is on trial for the one crime he may not have committed, under mysterious circumstances stemming from his bitter breakup with Dr. Girlfriend. The boys and Dr. Orpheus are forced to testify, but only Brock is aware that something far more sinister is afoot.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Dr. Venture finally learns the secret of his recurring womb nightmares when a stomach tumor turns out to be something far more sinister.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Powerless in the Face of Death

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Aided by Henchmen 21, 24 and a ragtag band of roughneck new recruits, The Monarch attempts to rebuild his villainous empire and rekindle his relationship with Dr. Girlfriend. A showdown at the local shopping mall forces his hand, and as he struggles to choose between revenge and reconciliation amidst a sea of violence, a wounded Brock falls into the clutches of The Phantom Limb.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When Brock is reactivated by the Office of Secret Intelligence to track down a rogue agent, he subcontracts his ex-girlfriend, the malevolently mercenary Molotov Cocktease, to protect the Venture Compound from enemies within and without. Love is in the air! Or is it... murder?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Escape To The House Of Mummies (Part 2)
programme.desc: Team Venture find themselves trapped in the clutches of a bloodthirsty Egyptian cult.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: The Phantom Limb and Dr. Girlfriend agree to a civil double date with The Monarch and some girl he met on the internet in order to discuss The Monarch's official re-entry into the Guild of Calamitous Intent. Doc and Brock become the unwitting pawns in a low-grade pissing contest when Phantom Limb's sics the Guild's commandos on the Venture compound to prove his dominance. Can Brock hold off an army? Can Doc escape death and finish watching the worst porno ever?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Baron Underbheit captures Team Venture when the X-1 crash lands in Underland while en route from a superscience costume party. Rather than execute them immediately, he inflicts an unspeakable torture upon them: they're forced to attend his wedding.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: When the Guild of Calamitous Intent finally approves Dr. Orpheus for his very own arch nemesis he calls upon old friends The Alchemist and Jefferson Twilight to resurrect their former super-team, The Order of the Triad. While they audition supervillain candidates at the Venture Compound, a jealous Doc isn't about to let Orpheus steal the show. Let loose the Walking Eye!

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Coming to State Dinner
programme.desc: The mysterious blinking band aid on Bud Manstrong's head might be the key to a mystery only the ghost of Abraham Lincoln and Team Venture can solve.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Kills

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: As Phantom Limb makes his stunning power play, only Brock can rally The Monarch's forces to mount a defense. The fate of almost everyone in the Venture universe hangs in the balance as The Sovereign reveals his true identity and guys and stuff explode all over the place.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Shadowman 9: In the Cradle of Destiny

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: At long last, The Venture Bros. peels away the onion-like shrouds of time for a look back into the troubled past of America's most beloved hydrocephalic former boy genius, to reveal dark secrets that even he didn't know about. What could Pete White have been hiding from him for all these years? And why is Brock in on the cover-up?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Hate is

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Love is in the air, kind of, when Dr. Venture encounters his childhood friend, Dr. Tara Quymn, in the Amazon Rain Forest. But while Rusty puts the moves on his old play date, Hank makes a play for Dr. Quymn's twin daughters, Nancy and Drew, who in turn, only have eyes for Dean. And the Quymn's bodyguard, Ginnie, is hot for Brock. Maybe. But all of their romantic interludes will have to be put aside when the terror of the Wereodile threatens their camp.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: What Goes Down Must Come Up
programme.desc: All basements are kinda spooky, but the Ventures are about to learn the hard way that beneath the foundations of the Venture Compound lie deep, dark secrets... great and small. Only the one-two punch of magic and technology can save Doc, Brock--and perhaps the planet--from certain doom as the boys recruit The Order of the Triad and Pete White to get to the bottom of a thirty year old mystery.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Bored and under-whelmed with his new Guild-assigned arch-enemies, The Monarch seeks to re-spark his old hatred by secretly visiting the Venture Compound while Dr. Venture is away at the Science Now conference. His passion for arching all things Venture may threaten to seriously cool things with his other love, Dr. Mrs. The Monarch, but does it really count as arching when there's nobody home? Or is there?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.desc: Determined to honor the father he never knew, Jonas, Jr. converts Spider Skull Island into a Team Venture Museum. Unfortunately, he invited all of his father's surviving friends and enemies to the grand opening. There's nothing like a party to stir up decades worth of sibling rivalries, bitter regrets and half-forgotten hatreds.

Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse

He was eventually extradited back to the U.S. to stand trial for the poisoning death of his wife, Rosemarie.

programme.title: Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case
programme.desc: The Defense accused Jamal Khalifa on the stand of making up his story about the defendant confessing to killing his wife, Rosemarie Essa. The reason? So he could get immunity for a 28-count federal indictment he was facing. During cross-examination, Yazeed's defense tried to discredit Khalifa who helped him when he was a fugitive after the death of his wife. By bringing up the crimes Khalifa was accused of, Yazeed's defense raised red flags to the jury about his credibility.
